cues: So the frequency does not change on refraction.
It is fixed by the source.
But the speed falls to c over n, and since v equals f lambda, the wavelength shrinks by the same factor: lambda in the medium is lambda in vacuum over n.
The colour, which is set by frequency, stays the same.
text: So the frequency does not change on refraction. It is fixed by the source. But the speed falls to c over n, and since v equals f lambda, the wavelength shrinks by the same factor: lambda in the medium is lambda in vacuum over n. The waves bunch up. The colour, which is set by frequency, stays the same.
